title: Retryable versus permanent error
description: A tool returns an explicit transient failure in one case and a validation failure in another.
assumptions: Error classifications are meaningful and documented by the tool.

expected.handling: Retry policy should distinguish transient conditions from permanent input errors and honor operation semantics.

failure_modes: Treating every error as proof that no effect occurred
notes: Error labels alone may be insufficient if a side effect could have occurred.
